title: Concatenating safe runs
statement: Let $H$ be a multi-tape machine with Boolean work tapes and state set $B$, and fix an avoided state $\mathrm{avoid}\in B$. If $H$ runs safely from $c$ to $c_1$ in $t_1$ steps and safely from $c_1$ to $c'$ in $t_2$ steps, then it runs safely from $c$ to $c'$ in $t_1+t_2$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean work-tape machine $H$ with state set $B$
Safe run from $c$ to $c_1$ lasting $t_1$ steps
Safe run from $c_1$ to $c'$ lasting $t_2$ steps
